<P style="MARGIN: 0px">Dear Ms. Nicholson:</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px">We have reviewed the June 2, 2008 Staff Comments
concerning the Form 10 filing by Superior Silver Mines, Inc and we offer the
following responses. &nbsp;</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><U>General</U></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px">1. &nbsp;Four additional risk factors have been added on
page 6 disclosing additional risks associated with the company&#146;s status as a
shell or a blank check company. It might be noted that in the first paragraph
under Description of Business &#150; History on page 2 the Company&#146;s shell company
status is disclosed. Additional changes have been made to the MD&amp;A section
in the first 3 paragraphs on page 7 to disclose information about the Company&#146;s
proposed business plan.</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><U>Item 5 Directors, Executive Officers, Promoters and
Control Persons.</U></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px">2. &nbsp;The disclosure in the matrix has been corrected
so that Mr. Lavigne is correctly classified as an independent director. </P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px">Dates were changed in several shareholder and director
shareholding tables updating from March 18, 2008 to June 30, 2008 but there was
no change to the tables themselves. The Market Price of Equity Securities was
updated to include market prices for the first two quarters of 2008.</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px">The company acknowledges that:</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P
style="PADDING-LEFT: 48px; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: -24px; FONT-FAMILY: Symbol"><FONT
style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><FONT face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT
style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>the company is
responsible for the adequacy and accuracy of the disclosure in the
filing;</FONT></P>
<P
style="PADDING-LEFT: 48px; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: -24px; FONT-FAMILY: Symbol">&#183;<FONT
style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;staff comments or
changes to disclosure in response to staff comments do not foreclose the
Commission from taking any action with respect to the filing; and</FONT></P>
<P
style="PADDING-LEFT: 48px; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: -24px; FONT-FAMILY: Symbol">&#183;<FONT
style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; the company may not
assert staff comments as a defense in any proceeding &nbsp;initiated by the
Commission or any person under the federal securities laws of the United
States.</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px">A letter from the Company acknowledging the foregoing is
included with this correspondence. </P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px"><BR></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0px">A red-lined copy of this amended filing indicating all
changes is to be filed on EDGAR and hard copies of the red-lined and clean
versions of this amendment will sent to your attention.</P>
